title: Workday
hint: The chief engineer opens the workday and closes it with their password. Once it is closed, technicians can no longer change anything of that day; without an ATS nobody photographs or observes a train.
noDayHint: The chief engineer must open the workday before permits and observations can be recorded.
lockedHint: Workday closed: technicians can no longer change readings, photos or records of this day. Only the chief engineer can reopen it, and that is audited.
genericError: Could not save. Check the data.

works.title: Today's work
works.hint: Service visits and corrective jobs of the date, with who did them and when.
works.empty: No work recorded on this date yet.

permits.title: Workday permits (ATS)
permits.hint: Safe Work Analysis: without a signed ATS for a train, no photos or observations of it are accepted.

observations.title: Field observations
observations.hint: The photo first, then whether the finding shows in it, and last what was done.
observations.isVisible: 2. Is the finding visible in the photo?

sign.closeHint: Type your password to sign the close. From then on technicians cannot change data of this day.
sign.reopenHint: Reopening is signed with your password and the reason goes to the audit log.
